name: agentforge
description: A fully local AI app builder powered by Ollama.
author: Syed Shadman Akbar

scripts.electron:dev: pkill -f agentforge || true && lsof -ti :7824,7825 | xargs kill -9 || true && electron .
scripts.build:backend: lsof -ti :7824,7825 | xargs kill -9 || true && rm -rf build dist dist-backend && python3 -m PyInstaller --clean locode-backend-mac.spec --noconfirm
scripts.prep:backend: rm -rf dist-backend && mkdir -p dist-backend && cp dist/locode-backend-v4 dist-backend/locode-backend-v4 && chmod +x dist-backend/locode-backend-v4
scripts.package:all: npm run build:backend && npm run prep:node && npm run prep:backend && npm run dist
